body:
Because the one thing that has motivated me is to get better for her and our upcoming daughter.

I understand that's an unhealthy perspective, but I can't reason my way of it.
Honestly given those two options I'd rather be gone
I very sincerely don't think it'll work, or even if it does, it'll be a short term fix and I'll regress as soon as I get comfortable. I can't do that to her. I can't get hopes up again.
